question: On a long PostHog session, does cutting a finished call's own text as well as its result cost passes or extra tool calls against cutting results alone, and against no cutting at all?
rule: PR106936 ('Member invitations'), the nine-turn task whose paired runs are published on the website and whose one bench session is already in the ledger (23.5M cache reads, $9.51, valid) -- so the shape and the cost of the arm are known before the run rather than estimated. Chosen 2026-11-15 as the single longest task available in bench/tasks, because a cut can only act on a session whose prompt passes the 140k trigger; not by any outcome. One task and three arms was the owner's choice of scope at $29 after a corrected estimate (an earlier $14 figure was wrong).
